name: Epindel
title: Blessing in Bloom
description: The heir to House Orlan. Though she is Asherah's childhood friend, her strong competitive spirit makes her act more like a rival than anything else.
introduction:
The future heir to House Orlan and a young lady known as the <color=#2A80D8>Falconet of Orlan</color>.
A perfect noble lady with refined manners and graceful conduct, Epindel stands in stark contrast to her easygoing childhood friend, the baron's daughter Asherah Stranis.

She takes great pride in the title of <color=#2A80D8>Falconet</color>, a distinction given only to the most outstanding heir of the family, and spares no effort to uphold it.
Valuing noble pride above all, she chose to join the Journey not only for herself but for the name of Orlan as well.
